topics.title: Starship Flight 14 official page — first orbit + 26 Starlink V3
topics.why: SpaceX published the Flight 14 mission page: NET Tue Sep 22 window opens 7:15am CT, first planned Starship orbit (~275 km, ~six orbits, ~10h), 26 Starlink V3 sats, Pacific splashdown west of Chile. Pending regulatory approval.

topics.title: llama.cpp b10994 Metal MoE NaN fix; nightlies through b10997
topics.why: b10994 fixes Metal mul_mm_id NaN when MoE activations exceed f16 (Mistral Small 4-class). Also HIP AllReduce (b10989), RPC weight-only hash-cache (b10985), Vulkan sparse FA (b10982).

topics.title: Ollama v0.34.1 stable; v0.34.2-rc0 out
topics.why: v0.34.1 is now stable (MLX create no longer experimental, faster /api/tags, MLX memory). v0.34.2-rc0 is llama.cpp updates only.

topics.title: USSF-259 scrubbed Tue; backup Wed Sep 16 8pm CT
topics.why: SpaceX scrubbed USSF-259 before fueling Tue Sep 15; backup window opens 8:00pm CT Wed Sep 16 at Vandenberg SLC-4E (B1097 13th, OCISLY).
